poc_plan: Objective: Validate Dedicated capacity sizing and latency SLOs during peak market windows for chat and reranking workloads
Duration: 2-week focused POC + 5-day soak run on reserved fleet
Test phases: baseline (cold start, kernel selection), load tests (ramped qps to target), soak (48-120h at sustained peak load), failure injection (simulate node loss + automatic fallback)

Representative prompts: 1) 40-80 token market status chat replies (low latency), 2) 256-token customer support responses (mid), 3) 512-token portfolio summarization (long tail), 4) embeddings/reranking batch jobs
Hardware candidates: 8x H100 (reserved), fallback 16x A40-like instances for throughput comparisons
Metrics captured: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail retries, throughput (req/sec), tokens/sec, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate, cost per 1M tokens
Success criteria: p95 <= 300ms for 256-token chat under peak load; sustained throughput >= 850 req/s for short-chat mix; soak stability with <0.5% error rate over 72h
performance_targets: Throughput target: 800-900 req/s peak (short payload mix) on reserved fleet
Availability target: 99.95% SLA for production Dedicated tier
Cost target: within 15% of internal benchmarked cost-per-token compared to current self-hosted runrate
poc_results_summary: Preliminary lab runs (non-VPC) with 8x H100-equivalent showed: short-chat mix (32 tokens) p50=28ms p95=120ms, 1k concurrent clients = ~920 req/s sustained; mid-length (256 tokens) p50=160ms p95=280ms at 350 req/s; 72h soak at 70% util stable with autoscaler triggers behaving as expected. Observed KV prefix cache saved ~18% token compute on multi-step chats. Failure injection: one GPU node drain resulted in 6s increased median latency while routing/fallback happened, recovered under 30s. Notes: results inside VPC likely add ~10-30ms for network egress depending on customer firewall. These runs are on test model variant (quantized) — final numbers may change with customer model pinning.
requirements_summary: Regulatory: must support data residency with audit logs and key separation. Network: VPC peering and static IPs for allowlisting. Operational: access to model catalogs, canary rollouts, automatic fallback to smaller model variants during contention. Commercial: committed monthly GPU hours + SLA with financial penalties for missed SLOs.

Risk: Network egress variability inside customer VPC — Mitigation: run final POC inside customer pre-prod VPC to measure impact
